bounds.domain: One previously dispatched request, one bound owner/grant, one explicit owner choice after the late-delivery warning, one exact provider receipt read and one local compare-and-exchange removal.
limitations: The prepared reply may be stale and the original request can still arrive at the provider after local discard. Local removal is not cancellation or proof of non-delivery. A new send is a separate explicit reviewed request; this projection never replays the original request.

Receipt identity mismatch, another non-prepared receipt or a failed read preserves the row. Removal is admitted only while the original owner is current. An already-admitted old-account storage write can settle after owner retirement without confirming to the retired renderer.

Compare-and-exchange applies atomically with its acknowledgement in this finite projection. Lost storage acknowledgements, arbitrary external changes, multiple concurrent controllers, arbitrary retry counts, live Gmail acceptance and a host that omits the warning remain outside the model. Actual-source tests exercise cancellation during the read, conflicting writes, changed provider outcomes and warning/control behavior.

assumptions: No fairness. The local discarded row is not recreated or replayed by this attempt; provider arrival remains independently possible.
Weak fairness of each admitted provider read and local write receipt, including failure, and local continuation. This promises neither provider success nor elapsed-time completion.
No fairness. A provider read or storage receipt can remain pending forever.
